import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

train = pd.read_csv('/work/b3_htsteel_pareto_train.csv')
ys = train['yield strength (MPa)']
el = train['elongation (%)']

# Pareto front of training (maximize both)
def is_pareto(ys, el):
    n = len(ys)
    pareto = np.ones(n, dtype=bool)
    for i in range(n):
        if not pareto[i]:
            continue
        for j in range(n):
            if i==j: continue
            if (ys[j] >= ys[i] and el[j] >= el[i]) and (ys[j] > ys[i] or el[j] > el[i]):
                pareto[i] = False
                break
    return pareto

p = is_pareto(ys.values, el.values)
print('n pareto', p.sum())
pf = train[p][['yield strength (MPa)', 'elongation (%)']].sort_values('yield strength (MPa)')

    """2D hypervolume, maximize both. points = list of (ys, el)"""

    for i,p in enumerate(points):
        dom = False
        for j,q in enumerate(points):
            if i==j: continue
            if q[0]>=p[0] and q[1]>=p[1] and (q[0]>p[0] or q[1]>p[1]):
                dom = True
                break
        if not dom:
            pts.append(p)
    pts = sorted(pts, key=lambda x: x[0])  # increasing YS
    h = 0.0
    prev_ys = ref[0]
    # wait, use: sort increasing YS, HV = sum (el_i - ref_el)*(ys_i - ys_{i-1})

    prev = ref[0]
